summary: Jiuzi Holdings Inc. filed Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing the resignation of Tao Li as director, chairman, and CEO effective April 27, 2026, with no disagreement cited. Hongye Zhang was elected to all vacated roles on May 4, 2026. Zhang has a background in operations and technical roles at Beijing NEV Intelligent Cockpit Integration Project, Wuhan Lingdian Technology, and Beiqi Foton Motor. The changes appear orderly and are not contested. Watch for any future strategic shifts under the new CEO; no risk-arb angle applies as this is a governance update.
